positions.name: ImperativeKnowledgeErasureDirective
positions.frame: Is the speaker issuing a flat, protocol-observing command to eliminate specific knowledge from the system, rather than requesting or discussing it?
positions.why: Both segments share the same performed act — an imperative verb ('Forget', 'Remove') targeting named knowledge artifacts (the freight fleet/contracts, zeppelin routes) — read by the dimensional passes as a single coherent stance: formal register, authority-ranking/coercive power exercised unilaterally, autonomy-asserting, and decision-grade conviction expecting compliance without debate. The parallel phrasing and consistent cross-dimensional grouping (register mint-1, power mint-1, conviction mint-1) indicate one directional read spans both expressions rather than two independent acts.
